how: Swift held-out sets (apple/swift-nio at b440f7bae8, pointfreeco/swift-composable-architecture at bf66bd83f3; last 300 commits plus the spec's curated commits): every loose candidate (29, no cap reached), labelled blind by two independent Fable agents following a counts-only copy of harness/LABELLING.md, 2026-11-14, before any engine run on these datasets; where the two disagreed the label is borderline. Plus the curated held-out items from lang-swift-extracts.json.
